title: Principal Technical Support Engineer
jobDescription: About the Job: Red Hat is looking for a Principal Technical Support Engineer to join us in India. In this role, you will be responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert. What you will do: Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat Open Shift, and Open Stack platforms. Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (Cent OS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations. Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence. Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency. Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs. Liaise directly with customers team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions. Scheduling: A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution. What you will bring: Linux Expertise: 6+ years of knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration. Networking Foundations: 6+years of knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment. Containerization & Virtualization: 6+ years of knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, Open Stack platforms, and Docker/Containerization. Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management. Communication: Excellent communication skills (written and verbal in English) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly. One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210),Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat Open Stack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in Open Shift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in Open Shift Automation and API Management). About Red Hat Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. title: Senior Architect
jobDescription: About The Job: A Senior Architect is able to act as a solution lead for small to medium sized teams delivering standard to complex solutions as well as influence Client Architects, technical individual contributors, and up to Director level (or equivalent) managers. They are accountable for having established expertise of process, concept, and technical knowledge in pre-sales and delivery. A Senior Architect is able to impact their region and has strong connections within teams outside of their career path. As a Senior Architect, you will lead the strategic design and implementation of Open Shift-based platforms that bridge the gap between traditional Dev Ops and modern MLOps. Your mission is to architect resilient, scalable environments that allow data scientists to move from "laptop to production" without the friction of infrastructure silos. You will be the primary advisor for clients navigating the complexities of GPU orchestration, Model Serving, and Hybrid Cloud AI. Note: This role may come into contact with confidential or sensitive customer information requiring special treatment in accordance with Red Hat policies and applicable privacy laws. What Will You Do: Open Shift Platform Engineering Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Design and automate the deployment of Open Shift clusters across hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, On-prem). Cluster Management: Implement Multi-Cluster Management using Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management (ACM) and ensure security compliance via Advanced Cluster Security (ACS). Scaling & Optimization: Tune Open Shift for high-performance AI workloads, including specialized GPU node labeling, partitioning, and autoscaling. Open Shift AI & MLOps Orchestration AI Lifecycle Design: Architect the full AI lifecycle on Open Shift AI, integrating Jupyter Hub, Elyra pipelines, and internal model registries. Inference & Serving: Design high-concurrency model serving architectures using KServe, Caikit, and TGIS (Text Generation Inference Server) for LLMs. Instruct Lab Integration: Lead clients in using Instruct Lab on Open Shift to fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) with proprietary enterprise data. Strategic Consulting Sovereign AI Strategy: Advise regulated industry clients (Banking, Healthcare, Gov) on how to maintain data sovereignty while leveraging Generative AI. TCO Analysis: Help clients understand the Total Cost of Ownership of running AI on Open Shift vs. proprietary Saa S AI platforms. Developer Experience (Dev Ex): Create a seamless workflow for developers and data scientists, reducing "time-to-first-token." What Will You Bring: Consulting DNA: 15+ years in professional services with a knack for whiteboarding complex YAML-wrangling into a business-friendly vision. Red Hat Mastery: Proven track record of deploying Open Shift in production-grade, air-gapped, or highly regulated environments. AI/ML Fluency: Solid understanding of the AI development lifecycle—you don't need to be a Data Scientist, but you must speak "Data Science" fluently (embeddings, vector DBs, fine-tuning). Security Mindset: Expertise in RBAC, Network Policies, and "Shift Left" security within the Open Shift ecosystem. Certifications (The "Gold Standard") but not mandatory Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA) – The ultimate validator. Red Hat Certified Specialist in Open Shift Automation and Management. Cloud-specific Architect certifications (AWS SAP, Azure Solutions Architect). title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription: About the Job The Red Hat Engineering team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team in Pune, India. In this role, you will work within an agile, globally distributed organization to design, build, and scale our next-generation open-source platforms and backend infrastructure using Python. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor to implementing robust, high-performing features, ensuring code quality through automated testing pipelines, and actively collaborating with upstream open-source communities. You will work closely with Product Engineering, Product Management, and site reliability teams across time zones to solve complex, real-world technical challenges for enterprise deployments. What will you do Lead the technical design, implementation, and optimization of highly scalable and secure backend services primarily written in Python. Drive high-quality delivery within an Agile/Scrum framework by actively engaging in all team ceremonies and peer code reviews. Build, package, and deploy container-based applications targeting Red Hat Open Shift, Kubernetes, and major public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Architect and integrate automated testing frameworks, quality gates, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, logging, profiling) into CI/CD pipelines. Act as a point of escalation for complex bug resolution, utilizing deep root-cause analysis across integrated distributed environments. Engage with open-source community development models, occasionally contributing upstream fixes or participating in technology forums. Proactively leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development workflows, optimize code quality, and explore emerging automation patterns. What will you bring Experience: Typically requires 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong background in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field. Core Language: Strong expertise in Python software development, best practices, object-oriented design, and framework architectures (e.g., Fast API, Django, or Flask depending on domain focus). Linux & Containers: Hands-on experience with Linux distributions (RHEL, Cent OS Stream, Fedora) and containerization workflows (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes). CI/CD & Dev Ops: Demonstrated experience implementing and troubleshooting CI/CD infrastructure (Jenkins, Git Lab CI, Tekton) and automation workflows. System Design: Solid understanding of backend web infrastructure, REST/g RPC API patterns, database systems (SQL or No SQL), and distributed systems architecture. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to analyze and interpret complex systems and workflows, with strong problem-solving and analytical skills and a keen attention to detail. Communication: Professional proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders. Mindset: A proactive, growth-oriented mindset dedicated to fostering a collaborative, transparent, and inclusive open-source team environment. Plus Skills (Nice to Have) Prior code contributions to upstream open-source communities or projects.
